newsitem.title: MALTA: Malta's Mid-Med Bank yr to Sept profit up.
newsitem.headline: Malta's Mid-Med Bank yr to Sept profit up.

text.p: Mid-Med Bank Group said on Thursday it made a pre-tax operating profit of Lm12.73 million ($35.6 million) in the year ending September 30, up by Lm3.47 million ($9.7 million) or 37 percent over the previous year.
The group said total assets increased by 15.5 percent from Lm875.67 million in 1995 to Lm1.011 billion in September 1996.
Group chairman Norman Mifsud said the outstanding performance was due to the various initiatives and innovations of the past four years.
"Mid-Med has developed into Malta's premier financial services group, incorporating offshore banking, bancassurance, long-term home-finance and fund management," he said.
The bank non-interest income had increased by Lm4.1 million. Loans and advances to customers, including the Lohombus Bank subsidiary, increased by Lm182 million to Lm644.42 million this year.

Customer deposits reached Lm851 million, up 10 percent. The group net asset value per share reached Lm1.46 from Lm1.30 per share last year. Group earnings per share were 21.6 cents, an increase of six cents from 15.6 cents in 1995.
Mid-Med's Group solvency ratio stands at 14.81 per cent while the Group's own funds have reached Lm83.02 million from Lm70.23 million in 1995.
